items: Card Container: The .card class provides structure and styling for each blog card, using a shadow for depth and rounded corners for a modern look.
Image: Circular styling (border-radius: 50%) and object-fit: cover ensures the image fits well within its frame.
Title and Source: The heading (h3) and source (p) text are styled with clear, contrasting colors for readability.
Read Button: Styled with a bold color, rounded corners, and hover effect for interaction.

blocks.content: With these styles, each blog card will look neat and professional, effectively showcasing individual blog posts. Now, let's create the layout to display multiple cards.
